state: Completed two 16-cell color concept posters and auxiliary 16-cell gray-equipment study; visually reviewed; awaiting user approval; no production changes
designSpecification:
EXACT grid of 16 characters: four ROWS C/B/A/S top-to-bottom, four COLUMNS MOBILITY/BALANCED/HEAVY/MAINTENANCE left-to-right. Cell labels C1 C2 C3 C4 / B1 B2 B3 B4 / A1 A2 A3 A4 / S1 S2 S3 S4. Full-body neutral standing, same scale and camera, entire hair and feet inside every cell. One clear character per cell. Portrait comparison poster, readable simplified shapes rather than tiny details.
THE CORE DESIGN RULE IS FOUR DIFFERENT CONSTRUCTION SYSTEMS. Do not reuse one crop top, shoulder pad, pouch belt and kneepad model across rows. Every tier must have a different chest OUTLINE, FASTENING SYSTEM, WAIST OUTLINE and limb-armor shape, visible without color. Do not mold breast-cup armor. All armor sits over opaque practical tops.
C CONSTRUCTION / IMPROVISED WRAP: raw canvas wraps and a broad DIAGONAL SASH, exposed rope/webbing knots, ragged asymmetrical cloth hem. Uneven reclaimed FLAT RECTANGULAR metal scraps riveted OUTSIDE cloth, no fitted military jacket, no precision pauldrons. A simple irregular cloth waist sash with side bags, no rigid uniform hip skirt.
B CONSTRUCTION / ONE-PIECE PATROL SHELL: a very distinct SYMMETRIC broad rounded U-SHAPED chest shield over a short civilian patrol uniform, rounded short collar and short sleeve cuffs. Large horizontal side buckles. A smooth CONTINUOUS CRESCENT waist apron/split rounded hip shell over shorts, rounded DISC knee shells. Clean old industrial product, no military MOLLE grid, no diagonal salvage sash, no narrow individually shaped breast plates.
A CONSTRUCTION / MODULAR MILITARY SLABS: TWO FLAT RECTANGULAR chest slabs with a clear straight horizontal overlap seam, squared shoulder yoke, upright vertical webbing rails and visible quick-release tab. A straight HORIZONTAL EQUIPMENT BELT RAIL carrying BOX-SHAPED pouches and separate short FLAT RECTANGULAR hip plates over tactical shorts, no flowing skirt or coat tails. Limb plates are flat TRAPEZOIDS and squared shin guards. Angular, rectilinear, issued military construction. No rounded breast cups or B-style discs.
S CONSTRUCTION / INTEGRATED OFFSET COMPOSITE: ONE continuous OFF-CENTER C-SHAPED TORSO SHELL, integrated diagonally offset closure with NO exposed webbing/MOLLE pouch rows. One slim shoulder ARCH and one open shoulder. The hip has two small smooth CURVED LEAF FAULDS, one distinctly longer diagonal rigid HIP FIN and one short curved opposite panel. Contoured narrow rib-like limb shells with recessed joins. Asymmetric monocoque engineering, no generic cropped bolero jacket, no A's stack of boxes, no B's symmetrical U shield. Grounded engineered composite product, no magical powered-armor glow.
Within each row, keep that construction identity but vary by ROLE:
1 MOBILITY: lowest-bulk short torso construction, flexible open arm joints, minimal hip modules, few pouches, one compact/simple knee guard or small leg guards.
2 BALANCED: standard torso, moderate hip modules, two normal knee guards. Clearly show each row's diagonal-wrap / U-shield / rectangular slabs / C-shell signature.
3 HEAVY: C3 uses ONE BIG UNEVEN SALVAGED FLAT STEEL PLATE held by crude straps, a mismatched flat shoulder scrap and rough rectangular shin plates. B3 uses a broad CURVED RIOT SHELL with large ROUND shoulder caps and a rounded waist apron. A3 uses broad STACKED FLAT MILITARY SLABS, separate trapezoidal shoulder and hip plates and boxy squared forearm/shin protection. S3 uses a wider but clean ONE-PIECE OFFSET BODY SHELL, one sweeping curved shoulder ARCH, large CURVED LEAF hip wings and smooth split rib shin shells. Do not give these four heavy outfits the same shoulder-cap geometry.
4 MAINTENANCE: recognizable service/repair role, compact hip TOOL ROLL and spare armor PANEL CARRIER, accessible repair joins. C4 rough canvas work wrap with external tool bag and rusty spare flat plate; B4 rounded civilian SERVICE shell with large accessible side buckles and curved spare panel; A4 straight engineer harness, boxed service pouch and spare flat military slab docked on a horizontal belt rail; S4 integrated flush SERVICE DOCK on the asymmetrical C-shell/hip fin with a curved spare composite leaf. No medical cross/healing devices. Do not turn all maintenance outfits into the same generic short jacket and brown belt.
Preserve practical neck/elbow/hip gaps. Maintain the SUBCULTURE costume exposure: bare upper arms/shoulders, a modest abdomen or side-waist opening and some upper thigh in every tier, including heavy (appropriate joint gaps). Secure opaque tops/utility shorts completely cover chest, pelvis and buttocks. No lingerie, bikini, cleavage emphasis, erotic poses, body exaggeration, weapons or helmets. Never elongate the short SD character to fit armor. Each row is a construction/design tier, each column a role; do not simply make armor bigger from C to S.

successfulStudy.prompt:
Create a neutral, nonsexual GAME EQUIPMENT CONSTRUCTION STUDY using the supplied fully dressed EDEL poster only for character identity, original lavender hairstyle/braid, compact SD proportions, neutral standing pose and 4x4 layout. Keep EDEL recognizable in all16 cells. Redesign the equipment entirely; do not retain the old repeated outfit templates.
Exactly16 full-body figures, grid rows C/B/A/S, columns MOBILITY/BALANCED/HEAVY/MAINTENANCE. Every cell labeled C1..C4, B1..B4, A1..A4, S1..S4. Keep all figures and boots inside cells. Original hair and face colors; ALL EQUIPMENT uses the SAME neutral MID-GRAY material and same lighting across every row. No row brightness/color coding. Shapes and garment construction must distinguish tiers.
Four fundamentally different systems:
C: improvised RAW CANVAS WRAP with one broad DIAGONAL SASH, coarse exposed strap knots, ragged uneven hem, a few FLAT RECTANGULAR reclaimed plates riveted outside cloth, cloth waist sash and loose side bags. No tailored military jacket, no molded shoulder caps.
B: old civilian PATROL UNIFORM with a SYMMETRIC, broad smooth ONE-PIECE U-SHAPED chest shield, rounded short collar/cuffs, two large horizontal side buckles, CONTINUOUS CRESCENT-shaped hip apron over utility shorts, ROUND DISC knee shells. Do not use C's sash or A's rectangular grid.
A: modular MILITARY CARRIER with TWO FLAT RECTANGULAR chest slabs separated by a straight overlap seam, SQUARED shoulder yoke and vertical webbing rails, quick-release clasp, straight HORIZONTAL BELT RAIL with BOX-shaped pouches and separate short RECTANGULAR hip plates. Limb guards are TRAPEZOIDS and squared shin panels. No curved anatomical cup-shaped panels, no B-style round shells, no flowing coat tails.
S: precision INTEGRATED OFFSET COMPOSITE: one continuous asymmetric C-SHAPED torso shell, diagonally offset integrated closure, no exposed webbing/MOLLE rows, one slim shoulder ARCH and an open arm joint. Two CURVED LEAF hip faulds with one distinctly longer rigid diagonal HIP FIN, recessed joins, slim contoured rib-like limb shells. No generic bolero/jacket, no A's boxes or B's symmetrical U-shield. Refined grounded engineering, no magic/powered glowing effects.
Same role remains recognizable within each tier:
Column1 MOBILITY: smallest torso equipment and few pouches, open flexible joints and small/simple leg guards.
Column2 BALANCED: standard tier system with moderate torso/hip pieces and normal knee guards.
Column3 HEAVY: broad protection, but four DIFFERENT constructions: C3 ONE LARGE UNEVEN FLAT salvaged steel plate with crude straps and mismatched flat shoulder scrap; B3 large SMOOTH ROUND RIOT SHELL with rounded shoulder domes and continuous round hip apron; A3 stacked broad FLAT military slabs, trapezoidal shoulder/hip plates and squared shin guards; S3 a broad OFFSET one-piece shell, one sweeping curved shoulder arch, curved leaf hip wings and split rib shin shells. Do not recycle one shoulder-pad shape across rows.
Column4 MAINTENANCE: accessible service fasteners, visible compact tool roll plus spare-armor panel carrier. C4 canvas wrap/external tool bag/riveted flat spare plate; B4 rounded civilian service shell/curved spare panel/large side clasps; A4 straight engineer harness/box service pouch/flat slab docking belt; S4 flush integrated repair dock on asymmetric curved shell/curved composite spare leaf. No medical insignia.
Practical opaque game uniforms, fitted utility shorts, compact short torso layers, clear arm/elbow/hip joint gaps and some exposed forearm/upper leg as in reference. Keep the reference's modest costume styling, no body emphasis or exaggerated anatomy. Same character proportions at every tier; do not stretch the body to accommodate armor. No weapons, helmets, mannequins or other characters. Professional neutral presentation.
Title "EDEL / ARMOR CONSTRUCTION STUDY".
Footer "SAME GRAY MATERIAL / DISTINCT CONSTRUCTION / CONCEPT ONLY".
